final_prompt:
You are an Investment Banking Associate in the Energy & Power coverage group at a bulge bracket firm. Your VP wants a precedent transactions analysis for a pitch to a midstream client exploring strategic alternatives. Build it as a single Excel workbook (Midstream_Precedent_Transactions_v1.xlsx), one deal per row with the relevant metrics across the top and summary statistics (min, mean, median, max) below.

Screen for and pull a relevant set of recent large-cap midstream M&A precedents yourself, using your judgment on the comp set, but it should hold up in front of a board. Build EV bottom-up as equity market cap plus net debt rather than the headline figure, and run the multiples that matter in midstream, EV / EBITDA and Price / Distributable Cash Flow (P / DCF), with each target's leverage and interest coverage to support the EV bridge. Source from public filings and footnote your inputs.
